heading: Kay kiti llamk'achiyta atinan yanapakuykuna
withdrawn: Llapan akllaykuna qechusqa. Sapa yanapakuy watemanta tapunqa.
serviceSends_google_analytics: Watukuykunata, ñawinchasqa p'anqakunatapas yupan. Google IP tiyanaykita chaskin, cookies-ta churanmanpas.
serviceSends_youtube: YouTube-manta videokunata purichin. Google IP tiyanaykita chaskin, cookies-ta churanmanpas.
serviceSends_vimeo: Vimeo-manta videokunata purichin. Vimeo IP tiyanaykita chaskin; kay kitiqa mana qatipanasuykipaq mañakun.
serviceSends_google_maps: Google Maps-manta mapakunata rikuchin. Google IP tiyanaykita chaskin, cookies-ta churanmanpas.
serviceSends_speech: Web maskaqniyki mana rimayta antachaykipi entiendeyta atiptinqa, kunkayki rimay yanapakuyninman (Google, Apple utaq Microsoft) rin.
serviceSends_github: GitHub-manta repositorio tarjetakunata, huk willakuykunatapas rikuchin. GitHub IP tiyanaykita chaskin, cookies-ta churanmanpas.
serviceSends_webstatus: webstatus.dev-manta Baseline web maskaq yanapay unanchakunata rikuchin, Google Chrome-pa ruranan. Google IP tiyanaykita chaskin.
serviceSends_aframe: aframe.io-manta A-Frame qelqa wasita apamun 3D rikch'aykunata rikuchinanpaq. aframe.io IP tiyanaykita chaskin.
serviceSends_embed: {host} nisqamanta willakuykunata rikuchin. {host} IP tiyanaykita chaskin, cookies-ta churanmanpas.
